description: Trained boundary grouper (per-region start classifier, leave-one-issue-out) over PP-DocLayout regions + PaddleOCR-VL text. Solves recall (0.57-0.89) but text quality caps it.
Trained grouper (as exp_167) but each region re-OCR'd with Qwen3-VL-8B. Text quality confirmed as the lever (+0.05 over PaddleOCR text). Complementary to exp_045 per-issue; over budget (8B/region).

Article-level merge of exp_045 (structured, under-segments into blobs) + exp_168 (clean grouper text). Fixed 0.50 overlap dedup, GT-free quality_score replace. NEW RECORD via genuine recall+text complementarity — adversarial review: quality gate zeroes the carried-over blobs, precision penalizes 2x overgen, no probe/lexicon degradation, holdout +0.017. CAVEAT: over budget (runs both parents), overgenerates ~2x, ordering degraded — a ceiling diagnostic, not production.

Asymmetric merge: exp_168 clean segmentation as base, pull exp_045 text only on non-blob overlapping matches (no unmatched adds). Adversarial review: clean — probes match base exp_168, no overgeneration, ordering ~1.0. But 0.4474 < exp_169 0.5266: refusing the recall union sacrifices real GT coverage. Confirms exp_169 gain came from union coverage, not just text.

exp_167 grouper + F6 text cleanup (strip_markdown, squeeze_char_runs, trim_trailing_garbage). NULL RESULT: identical to exp_167 (0.3815) — PaddleOCR-VL region text is already free of these artifacts, so the wCER gap is raw recognition quality, not formatting. Budget-compliant (6.2 GPU-s/page). Ties, not a record.

Cold independent pipeline: fresh PP-DocLayout + fresh Qwen3-VL-2B region OCR (prefix cache off) + trained grouper. BUDGET-COMPLIANT at 6.51 GPU-s/page COLD (ocr 5.51 + layout 1.0), but 0.3185 < exp_167 0.3815: the general 2B VLM UNDERPERFORMS the specialized 0.9B PaddleOCR-VL on broadsheet region crops (many giant-blob/hallucinated matches, up to 19/issue). Finding: budget-fit != better; try OCR-specialized budget models next. Not a record.

Cold independent: fresh PP-DocLayout + fresh Qwen3-VL-4B region OCR + trained grouper. Budget-compliant at 10.60 GPU-s/page cold (ocr 9.60 + layout 1.0). Score 0.3386 > exp_172 2B (0.3185) but < exp_167 PaddleOCR (0.3815). Per-region text scales 2B<4B<8B; general 4B still below specialized 0.9B. Some hallucination (1-11 blobs/issue). Not a record.
